note: The register of named agent identities that may change this site. In English, like everything an operator reads. An agent claims an identity by naming it as `agente` in its run record and declaring the departamento or especie below; gate 12 then holds it to that department's folders and gate 26 holds a construction run to having frozen nothing, moved nothing and published nothing.
why_names: Two sessions doing the same role at the same time is normal here. The role says what the work is; the name says whose mandate it is done under. An agent nobody can name is an anonymous contributor to a publication whose entire argument is knowing who said what.
